theme: Restraint of TLR/IL-1-driven inflammatory cytokine production
core_role: The shared pathways are the cytokine-level brake (suppressing IL-1, IL-6, IL-12 and TNF output and IL-1/Toll signalling) that terminates innate inflammation triggered through TLR2/TLR4 and LPS sensing.

theme: RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signalling: oncogenic activation and negative feedback
core_role: The shared pathways are the off-switch of the MAPK cascade (ERK dephosphorylation by phosphatases, RSK-mediated negative feedback, suppression of RAS signalling and pathway mutants) that counterbalances oncogenic RAF/BRAF-driven activation.

theme: Dendritic cell-T cell interaction during antigen presentation
core_role: The shared pathways frame the APC-T cell priming interface, covering dendritic cell differentiation and activation together with MHC-contact T cell costimulation and CD4 T cell proliferation, whose activated-DC and Th1 surface signatures appear among the additional sets.

theme: Development of glandular reproductive and endocrine epithelia
core_role: The shared pathways are glandular organogenesis and epithelial lineage specification (prostate branching, genital tract, pancreatic and adrenal/neuroendocrine differentiation), read here as the general branching-gland epithelial program that mammary gland development also follows.

theme: Ovarian cycle, folliculogenesis and germ cell maturation
core_role: The shared pathways frame the female reproductive cycle and germ cell life history (germ cell migration and meiotic entry, ovulation, luteinization and luteolysis), within which follicle growth, oocyte maturation and progesterone/gonadotropin endocrine control operate.

theme: Sex steroid nuclear receptor signalling (androgen, estrogen, progesterone)
core_role: The shared pathways are the androgen receptor transcriptional program and steroid receptor chaperoning, plus hallmark estrogen responses, framed as the common nuclear-receptor signalling core of which estrogen and progesterone receptor signalling are parallel branches.

theme: Non-vesicular phospholipid transfer at ER membrane contact sites
core_role: The shared pathways are PI synthesis and lipid transfer of PI/PC between the ER and other membranes, framed as non-vesicular lipid exchange at ER-plasma membrane/Golgi contact sites established by ER tethering.

theme: Basement membrane assembly and integrin-mediated cell-matrix adhesion
core_role: The shared pathways are structural cell-ECM anchoring (integrin, laminin and collagen interactions building basement membranes, hemidesmosomes and anchoring fibrils), the scaffold that dystroglycan complexes and neuromuscular junction organisation also build upon.

theme: Transition and heavy metal ion transport, homeostasis and detoxification
core_role: The shared pathways are cellular metal handling (zinc/copper/manganese transporters, metallothionein buffering and MTF1-driven responses to toxic metals), framed as metal homeostasis that interfaces with redox control, heme oxygenase and ferroptosis.

theme: Adipocyte differentiation and transcriptional control of lipid-energy metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are white adipogenesis and its nuclear-receptor (PPARG, LXR, SREBP) control of triglyceride storage, lipogenesis and gluconeogenesis, framed as the energy-storage arm of adipose metabolism set against brown/beige thermogenic and circadian regulation.

theme: Catecholamine neurotransmitter synthesis and transport
core_role: The shared pathways are dopamine biosynthesis and synaptic catecholamine/norepinephrine reuptake, framed as monoamine neurotransmitter handling of which general catecholamine and monoamine transport are the broader context.

theme: DNA replication origin licensing, initiation and replication checkpoint
core_role: The shared pathways are the initiation and checkpoint control of S-phase DNA replication (including ATR activation under replication stress), framed as the E2F-driven process of origin licensing through ORC, CDC6 and pre-replicative complex activation.

theme: p53-mediated intrinsic apoptosis following DNA damage
core_role: The shared pathways are p53's transcriptional induction and regulation of the intrinsic apoptotic program after DNA damage, framed as the upstream signal that BH3-only proteins (PUMA, NOXA) and cytochrome c release execute at mitochondria.

theme: tRNA charging and modification for translational fidelity
core_role: The shared pathways are tRNA aminoacylation and tRNA/translation-factor modifications (wybutosine, wobble thiolation, diphthamide on EEF2), framed as maintaining decoding accuracy of the translational machinery, including special cases like selenocysteine insertion and readthrough.

theme: Eye development: retinal vasculature, lens and ocular tissues
core_role: The shared pathways are ocular morphogenesis and retinal vascular/barrier formation (Norrin-FZD4 signalling, hyaloid regression, lens and cornea development), framed as the tissue and vascular scaffold of the eye within which photoreceptor and retinal neuron differentiation proceed.

theme: Nitrogen and ammonia handling via amino acid metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are glutamine, arginine/citrulline and aspartate metabolism in ammonium homeostasis, framed as nitrogen assimilation and disposal fed by glutamate-glutamine interconversion.

theme: Antimicrobial peptides and innate mucosal humoral defence
core_role: The shared pathways are the effector arm of innate humoral defence (defensins and antimicrobial proteins that lyse or agglutinate bacteria and fungi and sequester metals at mucosae), framed alongside regulation of antimicrobial peptide production and nutritional immunity over iron/heme.

theme: Xenobiotic and steroid biotransformation
core_role: The shared pathways are phase I/II biotransformation (CYP oxidation and demethylation, cytosolic sulfonation) of xenobiotics, alkaloids and steroids, framed as detoxification together with FMO oxidation and acetylation.

theme: RIG-I-like receptor antiviral innate immune signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are cytosolic viral RNA sensing by RIG-I/MDA5 and its TRAF3/TRAF6 relay to IRF and NF-kB activation and type I interferon, framed as the host antiviral response that coronaviruses modulate.

theme: Endosomal TLR nucleic acid sensing and its inborn defects
core_role: The shared pathways are endosomal TLR7/8/9 signalling to IRF5 and its regulation by self-nucleic-acid control (TREX1), framed as endosomal nucleic acid sensing whose trafficking and inborn deficiencies (UNC93B1, TLR3 pathway) underlie herpes simplex encephalitis susceptibility.

theme: Glycerolipid synthesis and glycerol transport and metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are synthesis of phosphatidic acid, DAG and TAG plus aquaglyceroporin-mediated glycerol (and urea) transport, framed as use of the glycerol backbone for neutral lipid storage linked to glycerol-3-phosphate and polyol/fructose metabolism.

theme: DNA damage checkpoints and p53-mediated cell cycle arrest
core_role: The shared pathways are p53 regulation and G1/G2 checkpoint arrest through CDK inhibition after radiation damage, framed as damage-responsive cell cycle control leading to repair or senescence.

theme: Xenobiotic and drug biotransformation
core_role: The shared pathways are phase I/II drug metabolism reactions (CYP2E1 and CYP1A2 oxidation, acetylation, methylation, sulfonation, e.g. of paracetamol), framed as xenobiotic detoxification induced via aryl hydrocarbon receptor signalling.

theme: Excitatory amino acid transport and neurotransmitter reuptake
core_role: The shared pathways are glutamate/aspartate reuptake by SLC1 and related transporters and their channelopathy-like diseases, framed as neurotransmitter clearance that terminates synaptic signalling, extending to glycinergic transmission.

theme: Behaviour and sensorimotor neural circuit function
core_role: The shared pathways are organism-level behaviours and sensorimotor gating (exploration, grooming, social interaction, prepulse inhibition) plus MECP2-regulated GABA signalling, framed as behavioural readouts of inhibitory neural circuit function.

theme: RHO family GTPase signalling and actin cytoskeleton
core_role: The shared pathways are the GTPase cycles of RHO, CDC42 and RND proteins and their effectors (formins, IQGAPs), framed as cytoskeletal signalling that drives actin nucleation, lamellipodia and adhesion turnover together with RAC GTPases.

theme: Fc receptor and SIRP regulation of phagocyte effector function
core_role: The shared pathways are activating and inhibitory Fc receptor and SIRP signalling that restrains phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, framed as the regulatory balance on antibody-mediated effector responses such as ADCC and type II hypersensitivity.

theme: RAS GTPase regulation by GAPs and RAS pathway mutants
core_role: The shared pathways are GAP-mediated RAS inactivation and its disease mutants (NF1 loss, RAS GAP and RAS mutants), framed as control of RAS activity state upstream of MAPK and p38 signalling.

theme: Xenobiotic and natural toxin detoxification
core_role: The shared pathways are phase I/II biotransformation (CYP and FMO oxidation, acetylation, sulfonation) of drugs, alkaloids and mycotoxins such as aflatoxin, framed as detoxification of dietary and environmental toxins.

theme: Mitochondrial respiratory chain complex assembly
core_role: The shared pathways are complex III assembly and insertion of proteins into the mitochondrial inner membrane, framed as biogenesis of the respiratory chain that also includes complex IV and respirasome assembly.

theme: Striated muscle hypertrophic growth and cell size regulation
core_role: The shared pathways are cardiomyocyte growth, sarcomere organisation and cardiac hypertrophic adaptation, framed as cell-size control of striated muscle in response to workload and activity.

theme: IL-17 and IL-1 family cytokine inflammatory signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are Th17 commitment, IL-17 production and signalling, and IL-36/IL-38 signalling, framed as the type-17 barrier-tissue inflammatory axis linked to IL-33, IL-23 and neutrophil-attracting chemokines.

theme: T cell receptor signalling, activation and differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are T cell activation and differentiation downstream of TCR and IL-2/IL-7 signals, framed as the outcome of proximal TCR signalling (CD3 phosphorylation, ZAP-70 recruitment) in T and NK lymphocytes.

theme: Telomere protection and suppression of alternative lengthening
core_role: The shared pathways are telomere capping, subtelomeric heterochromatin and ATRX/DAXX-mediated inhibition of telomeric recombination, framed as telomere maintenance that preserves genome stability and prevents ALT and senescence.

theme: IL-6/STAT3 and ERK MAPK signalling to AP-1
core_role: The shared pathways are ERK activation and its feedback inactivation together with IL-6 JAK-STAT3 signalling, framed as cytokine-driven kinase signalling that converges on AP-1 transcription and autocrine loops.

theme: APOBEC-mediated host restriction of HIV and retroviruses
core_role: The shared pathways are APOBEC cytidine deamination and RNA editing used as a host restriction mechanism against retroviral replication, framed against the HIV life cycle steps (entry, uncoating, reverse transcription) and Vif counteraction.

theme: Amino acid biosynthesis and catabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are synthesis and degradation of proline, glycine/glyoxylate and aspartate-family amino acids, framed as general amino acid metabolism that also includes histidine catabolism and formate one-carbon metabolism.

theme: T cell receptor signalling, activation and differentiation
core_role: The shared pathways are T cell activation and differentiation downstream of TCR and IL-2/IL-7 signals, framed as the outcome of proximal TCR signalling through CD3 phosphorylation and ZAP-70 recruitment.

theme: Axon guidance by ephrin, netrin and Slit cues
core_role: The shared pathways are ephrin and netrin/DCC attractive and repulsive guidance signalling and RAC1 activation, framed as growth cone steering via RHO GTPases alongside Slit-Robo repulsion.

theme: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signalling and its cancer mutants
core_role: The shared pathways are TGF-beta, activin and BMP receptor-SMAD signalling, its positive and negative regulation and its cancer mutants, framed as growth-suppressive signalling executed through RUNX3 targets and lost in tumours.

theme: Formyl peptide and chemokine-driven myeloid cell recruitment
core_role: The shared pathways are formyl peptide receptor sensing and chemokine production driving neutrophil, monocyte and macrophage chemotaxis, framed as myeloid leukocyte recruitment to sites of inflammation.

theme: mRNA 3'-end processing and mRNA decay
core_role: The shared pathways are polyadenylation, deadenylation, decapping and 5'-to-3' exonucleolytic decay, framed as control of mRNA stability and turnover through the poly(A) tail.

theme: Zinc, manganese and iron transport and homeostasis
core_role: The shared pathways are zinc and manganese uptake and the iron-export disorders of ferroportin and ceruloplasmin, framed as cellular transition metal homeostasis together with transferrin, heme and copper transport.

theme: Cadherin-mediated cell-cell adhesion and junctions
core_role: The shared pathways are calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion (CDH1, CDH11) and junction components, including E-cadherin trafficking and degradation, framed as epithelial junction integrity and its apoptotic dismantling.

theme: Scavenger receptor lipid uptake and macrophage foam cells
core_role: The shared pathways are scavenger receptor-mediated uptake leading to cholesterol storage and foam cell differentiation, framed as macrophage handling of oxidised LDL in atherogenesis.

theme: Cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport
core_role: The shared pathways are apoA-I/HDL-mediated cholesterol efflux and sterol homeostasis, framed as LXR-driven cholesterol export that prevents macrophage cholesterol storage and foam cell formation.

theme: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and rRNA transcription
core_role: The shared pathways are MYC targets and Pol I/Pol III and nucleolar chromatin regulation of rRNA expression, framed as growth-linked ribosome biogenesis controlled at the RNA polymerase I promoter.

theme: Thyroid hormone synthesis, sulfation and selenium metabolism
core_role: The shared pathways are thyroid hormone generation, transport and inactivation together with PAPS-dependent sulfonation and selenium handling, framed as control of thyroid hormone activity supported by selenoprotein synthesis and acting through thyroid hormone receptor signalling.

theme: Sprouting angiogenesis driven by VEGF and FGF signalling
core_role: The shared pathways are promotion of endothelial proliferation, chemotaxis and sprouting through VEGF and FGF receptor signalling, framed as growth-factor-driven vessel formation balanced by negative regulators of endothelial proliferation.

theme: Endosomal TLR7/8/9 signalling in dendritic cell activation
core_role: The shared pathways are endosomal TLR7/8/9 signalling to IRF5, framed as nucleic acid sensing that drives dendritic cell activation and type I interferon and inflammatory cytokine production.
